notes: Tool openers for this engine. Lifecycle entries come from the family forms and tier 2/3 operations from operations.json; keep only openers here. Owner direction 2026-11-08 / decision 2026-11-10 (M2): the database actions the inherited database node offered (dashboard, monitoring settings, dashboard editor, catalog DDN, test data, large-object files, advanced objects) are declared here for the provider tree, so a PostgreSQL server browsed through it keeps them. Labels match the inherited entries. M6 (2026-11-11): the inherited backup, restore, import/export and psql utilities are declared as openers (handler open_inherited_tool); the client identity bridge (legacyNodeData) lets them read a provider node as the inherited node it stands for.
